reason: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and I can get those on a coupon. The lab report is nice, but I would not pay extra for it when I can wait for a flash sale.
objection: $29.99 a month is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. The $24.99 launch price is for one box only, then it goes back up.
would_change_my_mind: A price around $19 to $20 a box that stays, or a coupon or flash sale that brings the regular price down to about $20.
